item.title: Show HN: Budgethole.com – Close the US federal deficit yourself
item.summary: Hi HN, I could never quite grasp the large numbers floating around in the articles and discussions about the federal deficit. So I built BudgetHole.com as a personal side project, a web app that lets you play with 150+ policy options and see how they would affect the federal budget. I've been learning a lot and I hope you like it! Bastian Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49407627 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
